    response = super().form_valid(form)
    user = form.get_user()
    ip = get_client_ip(self.request)
    user.last_login_ip = ip
    user.save(update_fields=["last_login_ip"])
    LoginEvent.objects.create(
        user=user,
        email_attempted=user.email,
        succeeded=True,
        ip_address=ip,
        user_agent=(self.request.META.get("HTTP_USER_AGENT") or "")[:300],
    )
    from crm.audit import write_audit
    write_audit(actor=user, action="user.login", target=user, summary="Logged in")
    return response

def form_invalid(self, form):
    email = (form.data.get("username") or "").strip().lower() or None
    if email:
        LoginEvent.objects.create(
            email_attempted=email,
            succeeded=False,
            ip_address=get_client_ip(self.request),
            user_agent=(self.request.META.get("HTTP_USER_AGENT") or "")[:300],
        )
    return super().form_invalid(form)
